notes.title: Trading Cards, Achievements, Hard Mode!
notes.content:
Trading Cards are finally coming to Caravanserail! There are five cards to collect.

In addition to that, I've added Achievements to spice your trading experience a bit.

And for those who already finished the game, there's now a Hard Mode available in the main menu! 

Enjoy <3
